subject.title: Add gated Claw hosted feed and lifecycle proof

question: Should ClawHub adopt the proposed `claw` package family, grouped manifest contract, and dedicated hosted feed as the experimental registry half of the open Claws RFC?
rationale: This creates durable cross-repository package, storage, discovery, security, and lifecycle semantics; technical review cannot determine whether maintainers want that product contract or its permanent compatibility obligations.

options.title: Sponsor the gated stack
options.body: Approve the experimental contract, land https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/3089 through https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/3092 in order after live proof, and keep the deployment flag disabled until the OpenClaw consumer is ready.

options.title: Narrow the final slice
options.body: Approve the concept but require this PR to be restacked after its predecessors merge so it contains only hosted-feed and lifecycle-proof changes.

options.title: Pause Claw registry support
options.body: Leave the stack unmerged until the RFC and OpenClaw consumer direction settle, avoiding a premature public package contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated stack
recommendation.body: Approve the experimental contract, land https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/3089 through https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/3092 in order after live proof, and keep the deployment flag disabled until the OpenClaw consumer is ready.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing hosted-feed architecture and its registry trust contract originate in this person's merged work, making them the strongest available routing candidate.
